import requests

URL = "https://example.com/big.bin"
OUTPUT_PATH = "big.bin"
CHUNK_SIZE = 8192

with requests.get(URL, stream=True) as response:
    response.raise_for_status()
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "wb") as f:
        for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=CHUNK_SIZE):
            if chunk:
                f.write(chunk)
